Welcome

Choosing childcare is one of the biggest decisions a parent can make.

At Daily Love Family Daycare, every child is welcomed like family. We provide a safe, loving, and educational environment where children can learn, explore, and build confidence every day.

Our goal is to help children develop socially, emotionally, physically, and academically while giving parents peace of mind.

Our Mission

To provide every child with a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment where they feel loved, respected, and encouraged to reach their fullest potential.

Our Vision

To become one of Montgomery County’s most trusted family childcare homes by creating a foundation of love, learning, and lifelong confidence for every child entrusted to our care.

Ages We Serve

Programs

Infants

Infant care may be available depending on current enrollment and licensing capacity. Please contact us to ask about availability.

Toddlers

Our toddler program encourages language development, movement, social interaction, independence, creativity, and early learning through structured play.

Preschool

Our preschool program helps children strengthen early literacy, basic math, communication, problem-solving, social skills, emotional development, and kindergarten readiness.

Program availability is subject to current enrollment, age-group capacity, and licensing requirements.

Core Values

Love, Safety, and Growth Every Day

Love First

Every child deserves kindness, patience, compassion, and respect.

Safety Always

Each child’s health, safety, and well-being are our highest priorities.

Learning Through Play

Children learn best through fun, exploration, creativity, and hands-on activities.

Family Partnership

We believe parents, guardians, and caregivers work best as a team.

Individual Growth

Every child develops differently, and we recognize and celebrate each milestone.

Learning Program
